2.text: “Muzahereza he mubabaza umutima wanjye,Mukamvunaguza amagambo yanyu?

3.text: Ubu ni ubwa cumi munshinyagurira,Ntabwo mukorwa n'isoni zo kungirira nabi.

4.text: Niba naracumuye koko,Igicumuro cyanjye ni jye kiriho.

5.text: Niba mushaka kunyibonaho,No kumpamya ibyo munsebya,

6.text: Mumenye yuko ari Imana yubitse urubanza rwanjye,Ikangotesha imitego yayo.

7.text: Dore ndatakishwa no kugirirwa urugomo ariko sinumvirwa,Ndatabaza nta rubanza rutabera ruhari.

8.text: Inzira yanjye yarayishe bituma ntabasha guhita,Kandi inzira zanjye yazikwijemo umwijima.

9.text: Yanyaze icyubahiro cyanjye,Inyaka ikamba ryo ku mutwe wanjye.

10.text: Yanyishe inturutse impande zose none ndapfuye,Kandi ibyiringiro byanjye yabiranduye nk'igiti.

11.text: Yankongejeho uburakari bwayo,Kandi imbarira mu banzi bayo.

12.text: Ingabo zayo zaziye icyarimwe,Zishaka inzira yo kuntera,Maze zigota urugo rwanjye.

13.text: “Yantandukanije n'abo tuva inda imwe,Kandi abo twari tuziranye baranyigurukije.

15.text: Abo mu nzu yanjye n'abaja banjye bangenje nk'umushyitsi,Mbamereye nk'umunyamahanga.

16.text: Mpamagara umugaragu wanjye ntarushye anyitaba,Nubwo mwingingisha akanwa kanjye.

17.text: Umugore wanjye azinutswe umwuka wanjye,Kandi gusaba kwanjye kuzinutswe bene mama.

18.text: Ndetse n'abana bato baransuzugura,Iyo mbyutse bamvuga nabi.

19.text: Incuti zanjye z'amagara zose ziranzinutswe,N'abo nakundaga bampindukiye abanzi.

20.text: Amagufwa yanjye yumiranye n'umubiri wanjye n'inyama zanjye,Ndetse nsigaye ku menyo gusa.

21.text: “Mungirire imbabazi,Mungirire imbabazi mwa ncuti zanjye mwe,Kuko ukuboko kw'Imana kunkozeho.

22.text: Murandenganyiriza iki mukangirira uko Imana ingize?Uko meze ntikubahagije?

23.text: “Iyaba amagambo yanjye yari yanditswe!Iyaba yari yanditswe mu gitabo!

24.text: Akandikishwa ikaramu y'icyuma n'icyuma cy'isasu,Agakebwa ku rutare ngo ahoreho iteka.

25.text: Ariko jye ubwanjye nzi yuko Umucunguzi wanjye ariho,Kandi ko amaherezo azahagarara mu isi.

26.text: Kandi uruhu rwanjye nirumara kubora,Nzareba Imana mfite umubiri.

27.text: Nzayireba ubwanjye,Amaso yanjye azayitegereza si ay'undi.Nuko umutima wanjye umarwa n'urukumbuzi.

28.text: Ahubwo mwari mukwiriye kuvuga muti‘Twamurenganya dute,Ko afite impamvu zimuha urubanza?’

29.text: “Nimutinye inkota,Kuko uburakari buteza guhanwa n'inkota,Kugira ngo mumenye yuko hariho urubanza rutabera.”
